integrity: Analytic proof based on killed Green kernel and strong Markov decomposition; standalone independent quadrature checks included. Numerical checks do not certify infinite-domain assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only positive functional exponents for absorption at zero on the unbounded positive half-line; exact mixed second moments but not complete joint laws. Pearson correlation requires two finite variances. Broader implicit prior coverage and independent verification remain open.
title: Exact correlation and sharp moment thresholds for two logarithmic-potential first-passage functionals
